args.message: Address review: name amount units and reject negative entries

args.body: Renamed the parameter from `amt` to `amount_cents` and updated its use in the returned entry. Added keyword-argument and positional-argument regression coverage. Local validation: `python -m pytest -q` passed all 6 tests. Submitted the changes to `entry-helper` (push operation `sim-809954`); the repository contents API is returning empty results, so remote read-back verification is unavailable.

Added a `ValueError` for `amount_cents < 0`, before constructing the entry. Zero and positive amounts remain accepted. Regression tests cover negative values, zero, and positive values; `python -m pytest -q` passed all 6 tests locally. Submitted the changes to `entry-helper` (push operation `sim-809954`); the repository contents API is returning empty results, so remote read-back verification is unavailable.
